name: Valentina Carrasco
bio:
Valentina's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching the Dakar Rally tear through the Atacama Desert. She began her career as a data analyst for a small Chilean rally team, quickly proving her aptitude for understanding vehicle dynamics. Her sharp analytical skills and ability to communicate complex information made her a natural fit for test driver coordination. She believes in fostering open communication between drivers and engineers to maximize testing efficiency and extract valuable insights. 

Valentina's meticulous approach and dedication to detail set her apart. She meticulously plans testing schedules, ensuring every session yields actionable data. Her ability to adapt to unexpected challenges and maintain a calm demeanor under pressure makes her a valuable asset to any team. She is driven by the pursuit of continuous improvement and a commitment to providing drivers with the best possible feedback and resources.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A slender woman with a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in the garage.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every testing day with a strong cup of Chilean coffee.
